description: This file defines the internal implementation of the ClientDirectory class in the Orleans runtime, responsible for maintaining routing information for clients (external and hosted). It handles local and remote client route lookups, updates routing tables based on cluster membership changes, and propagates route updates across silos in a ring topology. It also manages lifecycle participation and logging for routing operations.

classes.name: ClientDirectory
classes.description: Implements a directory for client routes, managing local and remote client routing tables, updates, and propagation across silos.

classes.name: TestAccessor
classes.description: A helper class for testing internal behaviors of ClientDirectory, exposing some internal methods and properties.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up client addresses for a given GrainId, checking local cache first, then remote directories if needed.

methods.name: TryLocalLookup
methods.description: Attempts to find client addresses for a GrainId in the local snapshot.

methods.name: EnsureRefreshed
methods.description: Ensures the routing table is up-to-date by checking cluster membership and connected clients.

methods.name: OnUpdateClientRoutes
methods.description: Handles updates to the routing table received from other silos.

methods.name: GetClientRoutes
methods.description: Returns the routes for silos that have updated routes since the provided version vector.

methods.name: UpdateRoutingTable
methods.description: Incorporates updates into the routing table, manages remote directory references, and updates local client info.

methods.name: GetConnectedClients
methods.description: Retrieves the current set of connected clients and updates versioning.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main loop for periodically updating cluster membership, refreshing routing info, and propagating updates.

methods.name: ShouldPublish
methods.description: Determines if the routing table should be published to the next silo.

methods.name: SchedulePublishUpdates
methods.description: Schedules a task to publish routing updates.

methods.name: PublishUpdates
methods.description: Publishes the current routing table to the successor silo in the ring.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Implements lifecycle participation, starting and stopping the directory's main loop.
